rawContent: @quim_james @NBCNews I don't think #MeToo went too far on Aziz Ansari. By and large, everyone recognized there are gradations of offenses, and what Ansari did was stupid and dangerous but not the end of the world if he owned up to it. Which he now seems to be doing.

@RadicalGoats @wavyshore @gartmartin9 These same people would instantly understand how serious and credible this misconduct is if it was a Republican Senator.

It's infuriating, and it's dispiriting to see how many people only support #MeToo because they assume *their* side won't ever face questions.
